checked.found: Hollerith's punched-card tabulator was used for the 1890 US census.
De Forest's Audion triode dates to 1906 (patent filed 1906, granted Feb 1908); the deck uses the invention/filing year.
Patent GB 148582 filed 21 June 1918 (published 1920); papers in 1919. 1918 is the filing year as the deck notes ask.
Bush's MIT differential analyzer was completed in 1931.
Z3 completed and demonstrated in 1941 in Berlin; relay-based.
Ran its first program on 21 June 1948 at the University of Manchester.
Accepted by the Census Bureau 30-31 March 1951 (physically shipped later, but sources date delivery to 1951). Described as the first commercial computer produced in the US.
Kilby demonstrated the first working IC at Texas Instruments in 1958.
Announced April 1964.
Went on sale June 1977.
IBM PC (5150) launched August 1981 with an Intel 8088.
First working ARM1 silicon, April 1985.
iMac G3 announced May 1998 and released August 1998 (not confirmed by my search results directly; consistent with the cited spine source).
GeForce 256 announced 31 Aug 1999, released 11 Oct 1999; Nvidia marketed it as the first GPU and it had hardware transform and lighting.
IBM Almaden experiment (Vandersypen, Chuang et al.), Nature Dec 2001; 7 spins (5 fluorine, 2 carbon) in one molecule via NMR, factored 15 with Shor's algorithm.
Roadrunner passed 1 petaflop on Linpack in late May 2008; Top500 No. 1 June 2008. AMD Opteron plus IBM PowerXCell (Cell) design, Los Alamos.
Watson beat Ken Jennings and Brad Rutter on Jeopardy! in February 2011.
Raspberry Pi Model B went on sale 29 February 2012.
M1 unveiled 10 November 2020.
Frontier topped the Top500 in May/June 2022 as the first exascale system.
Willow, 105 qubits, announced December 2024 with below-threshold error correction.
